Title: Wolfram Technology Conference 2014 Early Bird Discount Expiring

              Early Bird pricing is about to end for the 2014 Wolfram
              Technology Conference. Register now for the best price:

              http://url.wolfram.com/Mv33Lu/

              The conference will be held October 22-24 at our headquarters in
              Champaign, Illinois, USA.

              WHAT TO EXPECT
              Interact with the creators of Wolfram technologies. Hear directly from
              developers about recent advancements that will save you time, money,
              and effort.

              Participate in intensive pre-conference training and hands-on
              instruction for implementing these new capabilities in your
              organization.

              Talk shop with people who get it. Connect with your colleagues and
              Wolfram staff in topic-based "Meet-Ups", networking events, and
              roundtable discussions.

              A sample of topics covered:

                    • Cloud development
                    • Computational finance
                    • Connected devices
                    • Data science
                    • Educational technology
                    • Interactive media
                    • Social media analysis
                    • System modeling and simulation
                    • Visualization


              Remember, Early Bird pricing ends Friday, August 15. Make the
              Wolfram Technology Conference an even better value by registering
              today.
